upstream.purpose: Reference Commander.js implementation pinned at the v9.5.0 release tag — exercises cli_command_registrar shape recognition + IA detectors. Meta but useful: testing the shape against the canonical library it was modelled on.

Mid-size Next.js learn app — exercises frontend track (page_export, react_component, design tokens, JSX shape duplication). Pinned to vercel/next-learn `main` HEAD at vendoring time; this instructional repo doesn't tag releases. Re-pin to a fresher SHA when upstream rebases enough to matter.

limitations: Eight fixed cases on one machine; synthetic scaling cases are not real-world precision evidence.
First measured is not flushed OS disk cache; each sample uses a new Node process.
Ten repeats give a coarse p95. OS activity remains uncontrolled.
The first sequential batch had a TSX slowdown that did not reproduce under alternating adjacent processes; both sets retained.
Phase timings overlap and are not additive CPU time.
Peak RSS includes native/object overhead beyond the 32 MiB retained-data accounting budget.
Context and hook still analyze the full repository. No persistent cache or universal speedup claim.
candidate_scope: Analysis optimization snapshot, before scoped literal-scatter advice changes; executable hashes identify the exact builds.
